concept: School building with a paused calendar and student outside.
reviewNote: A school pause symbolizes leave of absence; distinguish from holiday or skipping school.

concept: Wind currents flow through a ring around floating leaves.
reviewNote: Wind is a visible symbol for invisible air.

concept: An excavation brush and a partly buried broken pot
Arrow lands in the center of a target with celebratory stars.
reviewNote: A successful hit symbolizes the source gloss A Success.

concept: A large clock and energetic lightning bolt.
reviewNote: Clock plus urgency bolt symbolizes immediately.

concept: Steak with a small cow provenance bubble.
Baby cradle with map pin over its home.
reviewNote: Birthplace combines newborn and location; source 生まれ can also mean birth or origin.

concept: A blue paint splash and blue-loaded paintbrush
Whole person silhouette highlighted from head to feet.
Thin and heavy versions of the same geometric letterform.
reviewNote: Typographic diagram uses letterforms, without a word caption.

concept: Young boy in shorts holds a bright ball.
reviewNote: Age and gender identity are not reliably inferable from appearance; owner should review people cards.

concept: One whole three-dimensional bread loaf beside two equally sized whole loaves, grouped by count.
reviewNote: All three units are whole bread loaves, not slices. Source counter 斤 has context-dependent quantities.

concept: Two brothers stand together with a shared family branch.
reviewNote: Shared family branch and age difference cue brothers; gender and family relationship require review.

concept: Fuzzy caterpillar crawls along a leaf.
Two houses almost touch, with a very short distance marker.
reviewNote: Short gap between nearby houses represents proximity.

concept: A palette with five colorful paint wells
Office building with workers and briefcases.
reviewNote: Office building stands for the organization.

concept: Pencil writes several lines on a composition sheet.
Small neighborhood shop with striped awning and stocked shelves.
Street bends tightly around a building corner.
reviewNote: Street corner scene; 角 can also mean the corner of an object.

concept: Shopper exchanges coins for a wrapped purchase.
reviewNote: Payment exchange represents the price or cost.

concept: Single crescent moon with two small stars.
Large multistory shop with display windows and shopping bags.
Flow diagram connects a circle and three colored boxes.
reviewNote: Generic flow diagram is intentional for diagram.

concept: Two delegates meet beneath different fictional flags and a globe.
reviewNote: Meeting delegates and fictional flags symbolize diplomacy without nationality stereotypes.

concept: Close-packed low houses and shopfronts beneath a distant city.
reviewNote: Traditional low-rise neighborhood symbolizes source Downtown; 下町 is more specific than any city center.

concept: Orange sun sets behind a low horizon and small house.
A gear, ruler and bridge under construction
Calendar with every day marked in sequence.
reviewNote: Every calendar cell is checked to show daily repetition.

concept: Three month pages each show one recurring marked day.
reviewNote: Numbered month pages with repeated checks represent monthly recurrence.

concept: Three successive repeated turns all receive a check.
reviewNote: All three attempts are checked; abstract recurrence needs owner review.

concept: Three yearly calendars with matching annual celebration stars.
reviewNote: Consecutive years carry the same event.

concept: Person bows toward another with a small apologetic speech bubble.
reviewNote: Bowing symbolizes excuse me or apology; culturally contextual.

concept: A feather with diagonal barbs and an exposed quill
Several distinct leafy trees form a small grove.
Circle, square, and triangle shown as an outline shape family.
reviewNote: Shape family represents suffix ～形, not a particular shape.

concept: Continuous timeline spans several consecutive calendar years.
reviewNote: Continuous multi-year duration symbolizes for some years.

concept: Ancient pot, old column, and long arrow reaching the present sapling.
reviewNote: Ancient objects and an extending timeline symbolize from ancient times.

concept: Most dots agree, with a small minority differing.
reviewNote: Majority diagram symbolizes generally or roughly; may be confused with many.

concept: Person waves a hand with motion arcs beside the raised arm.
reviewNote: Hand gesture is a concrete example of gesture.

concept: Three gold ingots
Archer hits a bullseye and earns a star.
reviewNote: A skilled action symbolizes good at; could also mean success.

concept: Tufts of green grass
Scissors, glue, and handmade paper house on a craft table.
Main office links outward to two smaller branch offices.
reviewNote: Central starred building and subordinate branches distinguish headquarters.

concept: Small rural home among hills, river, and fields.
Calendar with several day cells bracketed by a question mark.
reviewNote: Question plus calendar day grid represents how many days.

concept: Three people grouped under a question mark.
reviewNote: Counting people is represented by a question above the group.

concept: Repeated circular turns beside a question mark.
reviewNote: Repetition plus question represents how many times.

concept: Today calendar points to a page only three days ahead.
reviewNote: A short three-day calendar jump symbolizes in a few days.

concept: Person stands alone on their own platform after leaving supporting hands.
reviewNote: Leaving support and standing independently is symbolic; avoid equating independence with physical ability.

concept: Simplified torso cutaway highlights internal heart and stomach.
reviewNote: Simplified educational internal-organ diagram, not medically precise.

concept: Smiling speech bubble gives a thumbs-up while the scene shows a spilled cake.
reviewNote: Praise over an obvious mishap symbolizes irony or sarcasm; high ambiguity requires review.

concept: New worker with briefcase enters an office door.
reviewNote: Worker joining a company can resemble simply entering an office.

concept: A golden sun casting three broad rays
Open book releases a quill and small imaginative stars.
reviewNote: Book and quill symbolize literature rather than ordinary reading.

concept: Person speaks with large expanding sound waves.
reviewNote: Large waves distinguish loud voice from ordinary voice.

concept: Huge framed masterpiece dwarfs a small admiring visitor.
reviewNote: Large artwork symbolizes major work; source can refer to books or films too.

concept: Adult man stands with a small shoulder bag.
reviewNote: Gender cannot reliably be inferred from an illustration; adult person is the visual cue.

concept: A jar contains a large number of colorful balls.
Thought bubble shows a likely sun and a smaller uncertain rain cloud.
reviewNote: Weather prediction with uncertainty symbolizes maybe; owner review needed.

concept: Single marbled steak on a plain plate.
Coins beside a paper banknote.
Moon casts a pale beam and reflection on water.
Calendar page turns to the next numbered month.
reviewNote: Consecutive month numbers plus arrow cue next month.

concept: Year calendar advances by one year.
reviewNote: Consecutive year numbers plus arrow cue next year.

concept: Dark night sky with moon, stars, and sleeping house.
Person shakes head beside a large refusal cross.
reviewNote: Head shaking and cross symbolize no.

concept: Taller older sibling is highlighted beside a younger sibling.
reviewNote: Relative age and family branch cue older brother; family and gender require review.

concept: Person points inward toward their own chest.
reviewNote: Self-directed arrow symbolizes oneself.

concept: Adult portrait framed by the numeric age range 30–39.
reviewNote: Numerical age range distinguishes thirties without appearance stereotypes.

concept: One complete circular turn with a single tally.
reviewNote: One loop symbolizes one occurrence.

concept: Empty taxi interior with available green light.
reviewNote: Vacant taxi represented without an English taxi sign; source gloss Open Taxi is imprecise.

concept: Tree stump ring origin connects to the full grown tree.
reviewNote: Origin-to-natural-state metaphor for originally is highly ambiguous.

concept: Two evenly separated lines remain parallel across the card.
Person lifts a weight beside a full energy gauge.
reviewNote: Weight and energy gauge cue physical strength and stamina.

concept: Friendly pink pig with snout, ears, and curly tail.
A lavender cloud with falling blue raindrops
Mirror faithfully reflects a real apple with a check.
reviewNote: Matching object and reflection symbolize reality or truth; abstract and ambiguous.

concept: Recent end of a long year timeline is highlighted.
reviewNote: Highlighted most recent years symbolize recent years; numerical dates are illustrative.

concept: An open bag spilling uncooked rice
Two identical orange stars joined by equality bars.
reviewNote: Equality diagram intentionally uses identical objects.

concept: Two appointments converge on one highlighted calendar day.
reviewNote: Two events share a calendar date.

concept: Child with backpack enters a school building.
reviewNote: Entering school symbolizes school admission, rather than attendance.

concept: Three ascending school year steps with students.
reviewNote: Numbered school progression symbolizes grade/year.

concept: Magnified layered skin patch with pores and hair.
reviewNote: Educational skin cross-section; 皮 can also refer to other coverings.

concept: Blue sky with two white clouds
Pale sky-blue paint drop and matching swatch.
Bell rings with visible sound waves.
A single clear square with equal-length edge marks.
Student studies an open book with a backpack beside the chair.
Sun sends warm rays through a window onto a plant.
Simple educational diagram shows paired testes in a neutral anatomical cutaway.
reviewNote: Tasteful nonsexual simplified educational anatomy; verify anatomical clarity and suitability for the owner’s lesson bank.

concept: A hand points toward one nearby selected object among three.
reviewNote: Demonstrative that one requires conversational context; arrow selects the middle object.

concept: One separated selected object and a bracket enclosing all remaining objects.
reviewNote: Enclosed remainder group symbolizes the others.

concept: Middle occurrence is highlighted in a sequence of three.
reviewNote: Current occurrence is singled out; depends on understanding sequence.

concept: Several bundles of a thousand units beside a question mark.
reviewNote: Question with thousand bundles preserves 何千; source Thousands omits the interrogative.

concept: Three circular action cycles arranged as a countable sequence.
reviewNote: Countable repeated cycles represent times counter.

concept: A chosen answer matches the key and gains a check.
reviewNote: Matching answer cards symbolize being right; does not depict every sense of 当たる.

concept: Eye has a clear unobstructed line of sight to a distant flower.
reviewNote: Visibility illustrated through clear sightline.

concept: Person approaches the foreground observer along an inward arrow.
reviewNote: Approach toward viewer symbolizes come; distinguish from go.

concept: Ball descends three stair levels beside downward arrow.
reviewNote: Descending levels represent becoming lower, rather than physically falling.

concept: Hen with newly laid egg in a straw nest.
reviewNote: Egg-laying is a nonsexual example of giving birth/producing; may fit 産む more naturally than source 生む.

concept: Person leaves a foreground observer toward a distant destination.
reviewNote: Travel away from viewer toward destination symbolizes go.

concept: Ball climbs three steps beside an upward arrow.
reviewNote: Ascending levels represent going up.

concept: Ball moves into an open box.
Learner connects an open book to a new idea bulb.
reviewNote: Reading leads to a new idea as a symbol for learning.

concept: Hands assemble blocks into a small house.
reviewNote: Constructing a model house represents making.

concept: Two approaching people greet each other in the middle.
reviewNote: People converging and greeting symbolize meeting.

concept: Spoon swirls pink and yellow ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Pinwheel rotates around a fixed hub.
reviewNote: Pinwheel and rotation arrows show revolving.

concept: Runner leans forward with bent arms and long strides.
Person speaks a small three-dot bubble toward a listener.
reviewNote: Speech bubble shows saying something.

concept: Hands rotate a horizontal board into an upright position.
reviewNote: Transitive action sets a board upright; distinguish from standing up oneself.

concept: Moving ball halts against a firm stop bar.
reviewNote: Motion lines terminate at barrier to symbolize stopping.

concept: Ball is lifted out of an open box.
Person thinks about a puzzle piece inside a thought bubble.
reviewNote: Thought bubble with unfinished puzzle represents thinking.

concept: Two puzzle pieces fit together under a bright idea spark.
reviewNote: Pieces fitting and idea spark symbolize comprehension.

concept: Train tracks lead toward a marked distant destination.
reviewNote: Destination-bound train symbolizes 行き read ゆき; this word also functions as a destination suffix.

concept: Vehicle moves along a road with strong motion streaks.
reviewNote: Vehicle motion represents traveling/running of a vehicle, rather than tourism.

concept: A single clear triangle with its three corners emphasized.
University hall topped by a graduation cap.
Timeline of completed steps ends at a highlighted current clock.
reviewNote: Past-to-present span ending at current clock represents until now.

concept: River flows between two steep green mountain sides.
A collection of differently colored shapes and objects.
reviewNote: A varied collection symbolizes various.

concept: Person produces small curved voice waves from mouth.
reviewNote: Human source distinguishes voice from bell sound and larger waves distinguish loud voice.

concept: Compass highlights the leftward direction with a setting sun.
reviewNote: Map convention uses north up and west left; no direction caption.

concept: Building exit on the left with westward compass cue.
reviewNote: Left exit and compass symbolize west exit; orientation requires review.

concept: Three hidden objects under lids with a large question above.
reviewNote: Mystery containers symbolize what; inherently abstract.

concept: Clean month calendar page with a single large question in place of the month number.
reviewNote: Question in month page represents which month; distinguish from how many days.

concept: Clean year calendar page with four unresolved year digits and no day grid.
reviewNote: Four question marks occupy year digits to cue what year.

concept: Golden wheat ears on tall stalks.
Life arc spans baby, adult, and elderly person.
reviewNote: Life stages span a whole life; age depiction is schematic.

concept: Cutaway office shows people working inside its walls.
reviewNote: Interior office view represents within the company.

concept: Round ball of yarn with knitting needles and loose strand.
Foreground speaker points toward the facing listener.
reviewNote: Directed attention toward the listener symbolizes you; conversational pronouns require review.

concept: Younger shorter brother is highlighted beside older sibling.
reviewNote: Relative age and branch cue younger brother; family and gender need review.

concept: Young adult walks energetically with a shoulder bag.
reviewNote: Youth age category and gender cannot reliably be read from appearance; review against boy and adult man.
